title.km: វិស្វករសំណង់ស៊ីវិល

description.en: Plans, calculates, designs, and oversees construction projects such as high-rise buildings, bridges, and municipal infrastructure.
description.km: រៀបចំផែនការ គណនាគ្រឿងផ្គុំ និងត្រួតពិនិត្យការសាងសង់អគារ ស្ពាន ថ្នល់ និងហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធ។

responsibilities: Inspect on-site concrete and steel quality
career_progression: Site Engineer -> Project Engineer -> Structural Design Lead -> Project Director

description.en: Evaluates financial data, forecasts corporate performance, builds financial models, and provides investment guidance.
description.km: វិភាគទិន្នន័យហិរញ្ញវត្ថុ ព្យាករណ៍ចំណូលចំណាយ និងផ្តល់អនុសាសន៍លើការវិនិយោគដល់ក្រុមហ៊ុន ឬធនាគារ។

responsibilities: Assess market risks and balance sheets
career_progression: Junior Analyst -> Senior Financial Analyst -> Finance Manager -> CFO

description.en: Designs, writes, tests, and maintains software applications for cloud platforms, mobile devices, and enterprise systems.
description.km: រចនា សរសេរកូដ និងថែទាំប្រព័ន្ធកម្មវិធីកុំព្យូទ័រ និងទូរស័ព្ទដៃសម្រាប់ស្ថាប័ននានា។

career_progression: Junior Developer -> Mid-Level -> Senior Engineer -> Tech Lead / Software Architect
